text:
Maria Chen: Need a set of benchmark graphics and webinar hero variants for the April webinar. TL;DR: 3 hero images (web, social square, email header), 4 benchmark charts (latency vs cost, throughput per GPU, cost/unit breakdown, caching impact), and localized versions (DE/FR/JP). Source files: Figma + SVG. Exports: PNG + SVG. Can we get comps by EOD Thu 2026-03-26?
Alex Rivera: Quick Q: what's the webinar date? need that to set priority.
Maria Chen: Webinar is 2026-04-10. Marketing send starts 2026-04-01, so comps by 2026-03-28 ideal. Also need 16:9 hero for slide deck.
Jamal Patel: For the charts — can we reuse the latest benchmark CSV? Link: https://redwood-internal/benchmarks/2026-03-20.csv. It has latency, tokens, cost breakdown per model.
Sarah Kline: @Maria @Jamal got it. A couple design constraints: brand-safe palette only, avoid heavy gradients for small social tiles, use our benchmarking icon set. File formats: Figma source, exports: PNG (1200x628) hero web, 1080x1080 social, 600x200 email header. Charts as SVG + PNG @2x. Will need callouts for median latency and p50/p95. Any preference: show USD/token or percent improvement?
Maria Chen: Show both where possible — main callout USD/token, smaller secondary % improvement. Headline variants: 'Serving wins: latency down, cost down' and a shorter hero: 'Serving wins — faster, cheaper'. Keep legal copy short; include a small link text 'See benchmark methodology' (no long legal text on social).
Designia Bot: Automated upload: placeholder template -> /figma/bench-webinar-hero/placeholder-v1.svg
Alex Rivera: Also need localized headlines in DE/FR/JP. Copy is in this doc: https://docs.redwood/marketing/webinar-copy/localization. @Sarah can you flag overflow risks on social tiles?
Sarah Kline: Will mock localized lockups and flag overflows. Quick notes: German copy may need condensed type, Japanese lockup needs different linebreaks. ETA rough comps: Tue EOD (2026-03-24). Final exports by Thu EOD (2026-03-26) if no major revisions.
Jamal Patel: One more ask: include a small 600x300 microdiagram (SVG) showing Dedicated vs Hosted fallback routing for the launch narrative — simple 3-node flow with arrows and latency callouts.
Maria Chen: :thumbsup: Thanks team. If anyone needs raw numbers, ping me. I'll consolidate benchmark callouts into a single CSV and drop it here by EOD today.
Alex Rivera: Perfect. @Designia Bot can you create a Drive folder and set permissions for marketing + design?
Designia Bot: Folder created: https://drive.redwood/marketing/bench-hero-3063012345. Permissions: marketing.design, marketing.ops.
Sarah Kline: Acknowledged — starting comps now. I'll upload WIP frames to the Drive and tag you all.
Maria Chen: Great — tagging @Alex @Jamal for any copy/metric clarifications. Thanks!
